Anti-rubber-stamp: _attestation_ok admits an approval only when it carries a STRUCTURED attestation - a non-empty rationale AND a risk_acceptance that resolves to a GENUINE affirmative AND, for a review_disposition touchpoint, a finding_disposition - never a bare yes (reason unstructured_attestation otherwise). HARDENING: risk_acceptance is now normalized through _as_bool - a value resolving to False (a real bool False, or the string 'false' the one parser leaves for an unquoted false) is refused, so only a real True, the string 'true', or a non-empty free-text acceptance passes (the round-1 gap where the string 'false' was accepted via _is_str is closed). Attestation is PER-REQUEST: is_authorized considers only attestations whose request_id names THIS request, and if attestations were supplied but none names it the request is denied not_per_request (no bulk or blanket approve). HARDENING: a request with NO id is refused no_request_id BEFORE any per-request match, killing the None==None case where a blanket attestation with an absent request_id matched an idless request. A MATERIAL CHANGE to the bound artifact digest invalidates a prior attestation: an attestation whose bound_digest does not equal the request's current bound_artifact.digest is refused stale_attestation (denied until re-attested).

scripts/selftest.py WARP-0616 block: a bare yes with no rationale is refused unstructured; an attestation with no explicit risk_acceptance is refused unstructured; a review_disposition approval with no finding_disposition is refused unstructured while one WITH a finding_disposition and a reviewer role authorizes; an attestation naming a DIFFERENT request is refused not_per_request; and an attestation whose bound_digest no longer matches the request bound artifact digest is refused stale_attestation.
